scope: Documented hardware/configuration snapshot; no live inspection, flashing or motion performed. Unknown quantities remain null.

status_vocabulary.configured: Software or wiring-design setting; not independently measured
status_vocabulary.owner_confirmed: Historical owner observation/specification reported in source
status_vocabulary.fitted: Conditional inference from recorded data; not accepted global plant
status_vocabulary.unknown: No defensible measurement in curated evidence

controller.pin_numbering: Teensy digital GPIO, not connector pad numbers

cart.drive: Big Easy Driver; belt and pulley

motor_full_steps_per_rev.uncertainty: Motor step angle not independently inspected

steps_per_m.uncertainty: Derived pulse scale, not independent physical displacement

cart.position_feedback: Issued pulse counts; no independent linear encoder
cart.unknown_reason: These measurements do not identify mass, force authority, missed steps or independently calibrated rail length.

effective_length.uncertainty: Conditional passive candidate; fresh repeatability p95 fails. Effective length is not geometric rod length.

angular_damping.uncertainty: Viscous-model inference; not hinge torque damping

local_angle_offset.uncertainty: Local hanging-region phase only; not global calibration

motor.uncertainty: Frame designation does not establish step angle or torque

configured_max_height.uncertainty: Firmware default; RAM setting may differ on live rig

lead.uncertainty: Supplied 5 mm pitch interpreted as travel/revolution; multi-start lead must be verified

motor_full_steps_per_rev.uncertainty: NEMA17 does not establish 1.8 degree step angle

microsteps.uncertainty: Big Easy Driver unconnected default; physical setting not inspected

steps_per_mm.uncertainty: Conditional on motor angle, driver mode and screw lead

vertical.feedback: Issued pulse counts only; no commissioned encoder, limit contact or stall sensor
vertical.reference: Operator assertion of physical bottom; timed bottoming is not sensed homing

measurement_limitations: No physical measurements were taken for this repository creation.
Pulse-governor acceleration is command-domain telemetry, not an accelerometer measurement.
Masses, inertia, motor torque and force limits remain unknown; simulation values must be explicit assumptions.
No accepted system-identification model is supplied for hardware RL transfer.
